ui.settings.appearance.settings_page.cus: Customize the look and feel of Local Operator
ui.settings.appearance.settings_page.add: Adds the agent's Reasoning and Thinking rows to conversations. They stay closed until you open one. Reasoning only: narration the agent writes as prose mid-turn is transcript content, not reasoning — never removed by either display mode (by turn folds it behind the turn's bars, by response keeps it on screen).
ui.settings.appearance.transcript_displa: By turn condenses each turn to its answer. By response keeps every settled response on screen, with the turn's final answer still marked.
ui.settings.appearance.window_glass.desc: Lets your desktop show through the app window, blurred by the system. Off by default. Text stays readable on every theme: the see-through end of the slider stops where the lowest-contrast theme still passes.
ui.settings.appearance.window_glass.rest: Restart Local Operator to apply this change. The window keeps its current look until then.
ui.settings.appearance.window_glass.unsu: Translucent window is unavailable because Reduce transparency is on in your system accessibility settings. Turn it off there and this control will appear.
Translucent window needs Windows 11 version 22H2 or later.
Translucent window is not available on Linux: there is no system blur an app can ask for, and a see-through window without one would show the desktop's text through the app's.
Translucent window is not available on this system.
ui.settings.appearance.window_glass.cove: Which parts of the window go translucent. Sidebars only leaves the conversation and pages solid.
ui.settings.appearance.window_glass.inte: Left is frosted: mostly solid with a hint of the desktop. Right is see-through, as clear as every theme's text allows. Message blocks, inputs and code stay solid either way.
ui.settings.appearance.window_glass.mate: The system material behind the app. It also sets how far see-through can go.
